title: Brazil fossil lost for 20 years helps identify new reptile species from 240 million years ago
description: The missing fossil fragment helped scientists identify a previously unknown species that lived before dinosaurs dominated Earth, offering new clues about reptile evolution

title: Mathematical 'Code' Found In Great Pyramid May Reveal Ancient Secret: Research
description: A researcher claims the Great Pyramid of Giza contains a hidden mathematical code linked to the Moon, stars and planets, but the theory remains unproven.
